item: AI runs outlive their tab; indexing backlog drains on the server (R600)
key_paths: src/api/detached_stream.py; src/monitoring/tasks.py; src/api/jobs.py; src/scheduler/maintenance.py; tests/test_background_ai_runs.py; tests/test_index_backlog_slice.py
summary: Bulk summarize/translate, AI keyword extraction and custom prompt runs run on a server thread behind a bounded queue, so closing the browser no longer stops them; the task manager (and the terminal panel, via /api/jobs) shows them and can Stop them after the article in flight. The never-attempted keyword-indexing backlog now drains in the idle-maintenance window too (budgeted OO_BACKLOG_BUDGET_S=30 s, yields to re-index drains, corpus leases and writer jobs). Release-notes line (R319): AI summaries, translations, keyword extraction and prompt runs keep going when you close the browser tab, and you can stop them from the task manager; the Insights indexing backlog also catches up on its own while the app is idle.
